completed_tasks.name: Verify gateway forwards prompts & resources (LINCHPIN)
completed_tasks.progress: YES. Gateway (docker/mcp-gateway:v0.42.1) declares prompts{listChanged} + resources{listChanged,subscribe}; live probe returned a forwarded resource (beads://quickstart) and strava's 3 prompts. So tasks 10/11 are worth doing. Side-finding + FIX: gateway snapshots its server list at connect time and silently drops a backend that is down during that cycle (e.g. after `docker compose up -d` recreate) until restarted. Built mcp-gateway-watchdog (Docker container, Python 3.14, /opt/docker/mcp-gateway-watchdog/) that watches docker health events and restarts the gateway after a 10-min debounce. Tested end-to-end, running. Documented in ~/docs/MCP.md + SERVICES.md + ~/AGENTS.md (server-side docs, not this repo).
